generation_history.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create the MODELING SOURCE for one reusable solid TIMBER BEAM for Captain LivÃ©'s pirate cabin, matching the previously inspected room_target and cartoon wooden crate/bookcase artwork. One individual beam, not a frame or assembled room. Hand-painted cartoon wood: warm dark chestnut, broad restrained grain and a few tiny worn nicks, chunky simple forms, never photorealistic. No metal fittings, bolts, brackets, scarf, rope or text. Rectangular solid beam with SQUARE cross-section, straight long centreline, tiny consistent eased bevels, FLAT square-cut ends. Provisional physical dimensions length 2.4 metres, square section 0.24 x 0.24 metres (10:1 length-to-thickness). Beam lies HORIZONTALLY, long axis X, upright Y cross-section. EXACT FOUR views in ONE horizontal row, order FRONT, LEFT END, RIGHT END, BACK. Front/back are long rectangles 10x as wide as their height, profiles are genuine square end faces with visible simplified end-grain rings and centre heart, not another long face. The front/back grain runs horizontally along length; end grain is cut across it. Use strict LEVEL ORTHOGRAPHIC elevation cameras +Z, -X, +X, -Z, no perspective and no camera tilt. All four share precisely ONE orthographic scale and ONE height and baseline: if long side 1000px wide it is 100px high, and each end is100x100px, do NOT enlarge ends. Align all top/bottom extents pixel-identically. Keep generous truly white gaps, including between small end squares. Full beam in frame, white flat background, no ground shadow, no panel frames or captions. Soft even painted form shading, no directional hot spots. Avoid showing top surfaces in elevation; no diagonal reconstruction yaw. A complete closed beam, no cracks through it. Landscape sheet about3:1 aspect ratio, use most horizontal extent for the two long faces; native source detail should read cleanly at1080p.

Edit Image1 (the four-view timber beam sheet) to substantially stylize the GEOMETRY and SILHOUETTE, while preserving its four-view FRONT LEFT-END RIGHT-END BACK order, single scale, exactly shared126px height and baseline and horizontal long axis. Image2 wooden pirate crate and Image3 captain desk are style references only. The owner rejected the first beam as too much like a regular rectangular box. Make it convincingly hand-hewn CARTOON pirate timber: broad asymmetrical faceted bevels, slightly swollen cut ends, gently waisted middle, long edges following shallow uneven arcs rather than ruler-straight lines, irregular rounded/chipped corners and a few broad sculpted dents. Change the OUTLINE visibly, not only the grain drawing. Approximately8-12% silhouette variation along its length, no perfect parallel lines. The main centreline stays straight enough for a reusable construction module; straight central contact patches at the two cut ends so pieces can join. No log/bark, no branches, no split/destroyed beam, no fasteners. The beam is still square-ish solid timber with flat-cut ends and clear end-grain rings. Same physical shape rotated between all4 views: left/right show genuine irregular softened end cross-sections at the same orthographic scale as the long faces; mirror the corresponding silhouette front/back, do not create4different beams. Preserve original overall native pixel bounding heights126 for ALL views, align top/bottom extrema, long-face width~867 and end-face widths~121-122. Front/back grain follows the modeled curved surface in broad clean carved-looking cartoon strokes, rich chestnut with subdued ochre edge planes, not realistic scratchy fibers. Match the exaggerated worn wood geometry on Image2 and Image3, but no metal parts from those assets. Neutral soft consistent shading; pure white uniform background, no cast shadow or floor, no text or guides. Keep the native source canvas2172x724 and generous gaps. No perspective/tilted cameras, no extra views, no touching objects.

reuse_contract.placement: Repeat individual mesh instances; keep beam or board width/thickness fixed. Adapt length by cutting/extruding/re-UVing the module or fitting a final cap; do not stretch the painted grain along with a scaled mesh. Grain runs along the long axis.
reuse_contract.joints: Preserve central flat end contact patches; wavy sides and broad nicks are intentional cartoon shape. Joining planes, gap coverage and snap sockets remain untested. Check floor flatness and make nominal straight side contact lands in the model if needed without erasing the visible stylized contour.
